description: A relation is \(\Pi_1\)-definable exactly when its complement is \(\Sigma_1\)-definable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.piOne_iff_complement_sigmaOne {α : Type} (R : (α → ℕ) → Prop) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.PiOneDefinable R ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable fun x => ¬R x
